hero.title:
Your proactive
AI workspace
hero.lead: Fluso brings proactive AI to everything you do. Full context. Complete control. Deep focus.
hero.foundation: The decision's in a Slack thread, the numbers are in a sheet, the deadline came up on a call. Fluso pulls it all into one workspace that remembers, in your own secure environment.

howItWorks.title:
From scattered intent
to finished work.
howItWorks.subtitle: With Fluso, context switching is a thing of the past.
howItWorks.tablistLabel: How Fluso works, in five steps

steps.title: Tracks outstanding work
steps.copy: Reads across Gmail, Slack, Drive, and Calendar, including recent email context instead of only the latest message. Pulls out the actual commitments and stamps each one with an owner, a deadline, and where it came from.

steps.title: Performs complex multi-step tasks
steps.copy: Breaks the work into steps: research, draft, check, revise. GLM 5.2 powers the deep work, and per-chat Fast mode keeps simpler turns quick.

steps.title: Builds artifacts in formats you work with
steps.copy: Docs, sheets, slides, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDFs. Delivered files open in chat for Markdown, documents, and code; edits are handed back without losing your manual changes.

steps.title: Plugs into tools you already use
steps.copy: Gmail, Outlook, Drive, Calendar, Slack, Teams, Notion, Linear. Connect, review per-tool permissions, upload to Drive from chat, and recover stalled OAuth from one place.

steps.title: Flows through your communications
steps.copy: Replies, follow-ups, recaps. Drafted in your voice, polished before sending, and kept draft-first in Gmail until you approve.

capabilities.title:
Designed to automate
knowledge work.
capabilities.subtitle: The repetitive thinking work, done. Research, drafting, reporting, outreach, across the tools you already use.

buildDocuments.title: Build documents.
buildDocuments.desc: Sheets, decks, memos, contracts, briefs — drafted from your context, editable after delivery, exported without losing manual edits.

automateCommunications.title: Automate communications.
automateCommunications.desc: Replies in your voice. Follow-ups queued. Gmail stays draft-first and asks before outbound email or messages. Across email, Slack, and your CRM.

captureMeetings.title: Capture meetings.
captureMeetings.desc: Show up. Walk out with the recap, action items, and follow-up drafted.

buildAutomations.title: Build automations.
buildAutomations.desc: Set a Friday board memo or a 9am pipeline brief once. Relative times resolve to your local timezone. Plain English. No code.

organiseProjects.title: Organise projects.
organiseProjects.desc: A workspace that searches past threads, highlights matches, preserves attachments per chat, and shows what's blocking the next step.

installSkills.title: Install skills.
installSkills.desc: 100+ saved instructions, one click away. Connected tools keep encrypted credentials and can be reconnected cleanly.

exploreUseCases.desc: Nine industries. Each one uses Fluso differently. Pick the closest to your work.

connectors.title:
A memory of
how you work.
connectors.subtitle: Fluso builds a private graph of how you actually operate: people, projects, decisions, and what's owed to whom.

cards.title:
Everything captured,
still yours.
cards.body: Mail, calendar, docs, meetings, pulled in continuously and indexed inside your boundary. Never trained on.

privacy.title:
Private by design.
Transparent by default.
privacy.subtitle: Open models, auditable boundaries, your deployment. Your data never trains anything.

commitments.heading:
Open-source
intelligence.
commitments.body: Built on open-source models. Inspect every layer. Your data never enters training.

commitments.heading:
Deployable
boundaries.
commitments.body: Choose your boundary: our secure cloud, your VPC, or fully air-gapped on premise. Same workspace, your rules.

commitments.heading:
EU
data protection.
commitments.body: Hosted on Prem AI's confidential compute in the EU. GDPR-bound and sovereign by design.

commitments.heading:
Dedicated
sandbox.
commitments.body: Every workspace runs in its own isolated environment. No shared tenants, no cross-leakage, no training on anyone else's corpus.

commitments.heading:
Recoverable
workflows.
commitments.body: Auto-updates, offline recovery, provider hiccup recovery, and preserved in-progress answers keep long-running work from getting stranded.

commitments.heading:
No vendor
lock-in.
commitments.body: Connectors are standards-based. Models are swappable. Your data lives in open formats you can take to any other system.
